programs.description: Three unemployed lads help a politician, trusting him to offer them jobs after he wins. However, when he betrays them, they devise a clever plan to hold him accountable.
Chandrashekhar and Rohini share a deep love and devotion for each other. However, their relationship faces challenges when Rohini discovers that Chandrashekhar is caring for his sister's child.
Two police officers, one corrupt and the other an undercover officer, are assigned the mysterious murder case of Vijay Singh, an IT professional.
Gopu, a womaniser, falls in love with Chandra, a rich heiress, and decides to mend his ways by joining the army. However, she is devastated after he is declared dead in a plane crash.
Residents rejoice when an honest policeman arrives in their town. However, the policeman's latest case proves to be more challenging than he expected.
